messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Esperanto, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Esperanto line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
Aĥi kiom malfacila afero estas diri kio ĝi estis ĉi tiu sovaĝa kaj aspra kaj densa arbaro kiu en penso renovigas la timon!

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|--------------------|------------------|--------| | Ahi | Exclamatory expression of emotion | Aĥi | Ah! | OK | | quanto | Degree intensifier “how” | kiom | how | OK | | a | Infinitive marker “to” | *(none)* | to | **MISSING** | | dir | Verb “tell” | diri | to tell | OK | | qual | Interrogative “what” | kio | what | OK | | era | Past copula “was” | estis | was | OK | | è | Present copula “is” | estas | is | OK | | cosa | Noun “thing” | afero | thing | OK | | dura | Adjective “hard / difficult” | malfacila | hard / difficult | OK | | esta | Demonstrative “this” | ĉi tiu | this | OK | | selva | Noun “forest / wood” | arbaro | forest / wood | OK | | selvaggia | Adjective “wild” | sovaĝa | wild | OK | | e (1) | Coordinating conjunction “and” | kaj | and | OK | | aspra | Adjective “rough” | aspra | rough | OK | | e (2) | Coordinating conjunction “and” | kaj | and | OK | | forte | Adjective “dense / strong” | densa | dense | OK | | che | Relative pronoun “which” | kiu | which | OK | | nel | Preposition + article “in the” | en | in | OK | | pensier | Noun “thought” | penso | thought | OK | | rinova | Verb “renews” | renovigas | renews | OK | | la | Definite article “the” | la | the | OK | | paura! | Noun “fear” (accusative) | timon! | fear | OK |
### Issues Detected - **MISSING**: *a* (infinitive marker “to”) has no explicit counterpart in the Esperanto rendering. All other items are correctly translated and grammatically sound.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Esperanto script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Esperanto text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 4: - Original: **Aĥi kiom malfacila afero estas diri kio ĝi estis** - Issue: Missing infinitive marker “a” (to) - Corrected: **Aĥi kiom malfacila afero estas **por** diri kio ĝi estis**
- Line 5: - Original: **ĉi tiu sovaĝa kaj aspra kaj densa arbaro** - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 6: - Original: **kiu en penso renovigas la timon!** - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
